notes:
Nashama TV iOS v1.1.13:
- Fixed live channels stopping playback after about 30 seconds -- caused by a stale, no-longer-refreshing HLS manifest being served from cache instead of fetched fresh.
- v1.1.12 fixes carried forward: favorite button in the live player, sort choice no longer resets between tabs, Series defaults to Recently Updated.
- Install with Sideloadly or xtool using your Apple ID; re-sideload every 7 days to keep it signed.
